# Nya attacker lyfter oljepriset – lugn start på börsveckan väntas

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A calm start to the trading week with oil creeping toward $84/barrel on a drawn-out conflict, raising stagflation concerns (higher fertilizer, diesel and food costs feeding inflation and rates) even as equity markets keep hitting records on an AI-driven capex boom. The main deep-dive is on Swedish investment companies, where several have swung from discount to premium — Industrivärden and Investor now trade at ~5% premiums (seen as less attractive), while Bure has emerged as the more attractive pick versus Creades. Sivers was the day's winner on strong semiconductor sector momentum.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BURE — Bure | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Discount still roughly intact after summer moves while holdings normalized; framed as the more attractive investment company vs Creades.

#### Reasoning

After the summer rally, discounts across investment companies compressed but Bure's stayed near prior levels while its holdings (incl. Silex/Sivers) came down. Hosts explicitly call Bure the alternative that has emerged as more attractive. Main caveat is Mycronic (>half of NAV) being seen as somewhat expensive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Bure's discount closes to par like Creades
- if Mycronic valuation corrects sharply
- if underlying holdings re-rate lower

> *"Bure är väl det alternativet som har seglat upp som mer attraktivt efter den här perioden."*

---

### ⛔ INDU-C — Industrivärden | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Trading at ~5% premium on a fully listed portfolio you could replicate more cheaply by buying underlying shares.

#### Reasoning

Industrivärden's portfolio is entirely listed, so a 5% premium is hard to justify — investors can buy the underlying shares directly and cheaper, and even cherry-pick holdings. Hosts flag it as having become less attractive after the summer.

#### Sell Triggers

- if premium reverts to a discount
- if underlying holdings sell off making NAV attractive

> *"vi har industrivärden på 5 % premie. Det är en helt noterad portfölj så att du kan ju köpa de underliggande aktierna istället för ett billigare pris."*

---

### 🟡 INVE-B — Investor | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

~5% premium partly justified by unlisted holdings; hosts advise retail to pick cheaper B share over A since returns are identical.

#### Reasoning

Investor rarely trades at a premium but now sits ~5%, somewhat defensible given its unlisted portfolio if seen as undervalued. Hosts see it as less attractive than before but not a clear sell; key actionable point is choosing the ~2% cheaper B share over the voting A share for retail.

#### Sell Triggers

- if premium widens without NAV support
- if unlisted holdings are marked down

> *"Investor brukar inte heller ha premie. Nu är det 5 % premie där med. Där finns dock den onoterade delen."*

---

### 🟡 CRED-A — Creades | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Previously the preferred pick (holds cheaper Avanza), but its discount has now nearly disappeared, reducing upside.

#### Reasoning

Hosts earlier chose Creades over Bure because its discount was attractive and its main holding Avanza wasn't as expensive as Bure's Mycronic. Since then Creades' discount has almost vanished, so the relative edge is gone and it is no longer the preferred name.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it moves to a premium
- if Avanza valuation deteriorates

> *"Nu har egentligen rabatten försvunnit nästan i Creades medan Bure ligger kvar på ungefär samma nivåer."*

---

### 🟠 SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Day's winner up ~11.5% on semiconductor/AI momentum and TSMC read-across; models view the underlying (Silex) as a bit overvalued.

#### Reasoning

Sivers rallied hard on sector strength (TSMC monthly figures, datacenter/AI capex boom) and is the day's top performer. However hosts consider the name somewhat overvalued in their models (~30% discount view vs price on holdings), so upside is momentum-driven rather than valuation-supported.

#### Sell Triggers

- if TSMC/semiconductor momentum reverses
- if valuation multiples compress
- if orders disappoint

> *"vi tyckte väl att Silex var lite övervärderat"*

---

### 🟠 YUBICO — Yubico | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Raised target price from Pareto and strong report (+~40%) as valuation had fallen; slipping today after the rocket move.

#### Reasoning

After the valuation compressed, a modestly better report — strong especially on margins — triggered a ~40% rebound and a Pareto target-price hike. Momentum is positive but the stock is pulling back today after the surge, so it warrants monitoring rather than chasing.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin improvement doesn't persist next quarter
- if the post-report gains fully reverse

> *"Yubico tappar lite trots att de har fått en ökad riktkurs från Pareto."*
